_provenance: §3.2.3 T2.07. The STRUCTURAL required prop of each priority type — the prop whose absence breaks the component — evidenced by presence on 100% of that type's corpus instances (mined from packages/sfs/corpus), never the framework `required` flag (unobtainable offline) and never the full coincidentally-100% set (which sweeps in styling props). A type with no corpus instance offline carries no record and T2.07 disposes it `na`; the na count only falls (BL-004 mines the rest live).
